'''Revised Dagobah''' is the 17th Star Wars CCG product, published by Decipher in December 1999. It is the white-border Revised Unlimited reprint of [[Dagobah Limited]]. CardGuide numbering: 17th product.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]</ref>

It reprints the 180-card Limited pool with Special Edition–era revised text. The unique-card list is on [[Dagobah Limited]]. The set image is a Revised Edition 9-card booster box.<ref name="encyc" />

== Packaging ==
Sold in 9-card booster packs (MSRP $2.50: 5 commons, 3 uncommons, 1 rare) and 30-pack boxes. Each box included a fold-out Rules Supplement.<ref name="encyc" />
